description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is a critical leadership opportunity for a Registered Nurse passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for nursing staff.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and driving continuous quality improvement initiatives. We are looking to fill this role urgently and offer a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year for the right candidate.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Proven leadership experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
